# Wonder Herb (康草堂)

> Hong Kong natural health brand. Core line: Coriolus versicolor
> polysaccharide-peptide (雲芝糖肽, PSP), plus T3, PT3, and related formulas.
> Content: product specs, ingredient testing, research references, and FAQs.
> Primary language: zh-Hant (Hong Kong). Manufactured in a Canadian GMP facility.

## Products
- [產品介紹](https://www.wonder-herb.com/產品介紹.html): Full product line and specifications.
- [雲芝糖肽精華 PSP — 試用裝](https://www.wonder-herb.com/產品_雲芝糖肽精華_A.html): 60-capsule trial pack.
- [雲芝糖肽精華 PSP — 標準裝](https://www.wonder-herb.com/產品_雲芝糖肽精華_B.html): 500-capsule standard pack.
- [PT3 配方](https://www.wonder-herb.com/產品_PT3.html)
- [T3 配方](https://www.wonder-herb.com/產品_T3.html)
- [乙肝清](https://www.wonder-herb.com/產品_乙肝清.html): Herbal liver support.
- [憶活素](https://www.wonder-herb.com/產品_憶活素.html)
